Markets.summary: China's stock markets edged higher on Tuesday, driven by gains in agriculture, energy, and gold shares that offset losses in technology. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's Hang Seng index fell due to Middle East tensions and caution ahead of upcoming US inflation data.

Markets.summary: Biocon shares rose 2% after securing a 10-year Pertuzumab supply contract in Brazil through a consortium. This agreement grants the consortium full allocation under Brazil's PDP programme, capturing about 70% of the public-sector demand for the breast cancer therapy.
